newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude gets EU approval for heart valve.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude gets EU approval for heart valve.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said it received CE Mark approval for the SJM Biocor stented pericardial heart valve.
The approval allows the company to sell the pig-tissue heart valve in the nations of the European Union.
The valve is made by Brazil's Biocor Industria E Pesquisas Ltd, which was acquired in September 1996 by St. Jude, the world's largest artificial heart valve manufacturer.

"We expect the SJM Biocor products to contribute to the growth of our European business beginning this year, along with other planned new product introductions. We have essentially completed the transition from distribution to direct sales of SJM Biocor products," said Terry Shepherd, president of the St. Jude heart valve division.
